notes.title: Fire & Poison Swords, Status Effects, and Dual Weapon Tease
notes.content:
[i]Hello, skeleton slayers!
Here's what's new (and coming soon) in [b]Skeleton Arena[/b]:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/64a33b1345105bf93e1a134ad70e976867e9d15e.png[/img]
[h2]New Elemental Swords: Fire & Poison[/h2]
Two new weapons are now available for testing:
- [b]Fire Sword[/b] – Applies a short burning effect that deals damage over time.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/7169f43bebad9d12cc127bb66256b86294dae847.gif[/img]
- [b]Poison Sword[/b] – Inflicts a venom status that slowly drains enemy health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/1794d046106fd87f6e2dcc00670fcd32f98b975f.gif[/img]
Both weapons have [b]4 upgrade levels[/b], making them more powerful and improving their effects. As they level up, the burn lasts longer, and poison stacks faster!

Enemies now display [u]status icons[/u] above their heads so you can track what effects are active in combat.

---
[h2]Status Effects System (Work in Progress)[/h2]

We’ve started building a full [u][b]status effect system[/b][/u] that will support:
[h3]
- Doom
- Burn  
- Poison  
- Bleed  
- Freeze  
- Stun
...and more![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/4528d4b185919fb4b788460c03eb9936043cb6a1.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/ba11573442ab8dcd0533348e3ca826ef287d36df.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/95f393b68a658c685899036f535cc71f27afdbf6.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620817/ba11573442ab8dcd0533348e3ca826ef287d36df.gif[/img]
[i]These effects will eventually be used by enemies, weapons, abilities, consumables, and even traps.
[/i]
---

[h2]Dual Weapon Combat (Coming Soon)[/h2]

We're also working on a system for [b]main and secondary weapons[/b], allowing combinations like:

- Sword + Shield  
- Bow + Dagger  
- Staff + Magic Book  

This will open up new strategies and playstyles — stay tuned for more in the next updates!

---

Thanks for reading and following the development of [b]Skeleton Arena[/b]. If you’ve got feedback or ideas — we’d love to hear them in the Steam Discussions!

Until next time, [b]gugadev[/b].
